# Event Planner Skill for Muse

Plan any event end-to-end — birthdays, weddings, dinner parties, offsites, conferences, fundraisers: it starts by locking the four constraints (date, headcount, budget, venue), then sets the budget envelope with a 10–15% contingency, sizes the venue to the guest list with a weather backup plan, builds the guest and RSVP plan with dietary and accessibility capture, backward-plans the timeline from the event date, assembles the vendor and task checklist (quote, deposit, confirmation date, contact per vendor), writes a minute-by-minute day-of run-of-show with an owner per block, and bakes in contingencies (weather, no-shows, vendor failure). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it plans and coordinates — it never books vendors and never guarantees live prices or availability, and for large or regulated events it rightly flags that licensed professional help and local regulations apply. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
